x: Dick Stride has been wounded in Italy, more news is awaited. Meanwhile, all the best for a quick recovery, Dick.
Dick Stride has recovered from his wounds which he got in Italy, and has since been twice mentioned in dispatches. Eric Keyworth met Len Spooner in Jerusalem and succeeded him as Sports Officer.
Dick Stride read a recent Belgravian in a foxhole 20 yards from "Jerry." He was second in a Brigade three miles cross-country race, being beaten on the tape in 15.6.
